item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A relatively cooler northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow, it will be windy over the region. An upper-air disturbance will bring heavy showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coastal areas of southern China on Sunday and Monday. With the areas of showers departing gradually, the weather over southern China will improve gradually in the following couple of days. It will be hot in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 01/05 (Sunday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with showers. Showers will be more frequent at times. Temperature will fall gradually.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 02/05 (Monday)
